comment_threads_purpose_context.name: comment_threads_purpose_context
comment_threads_purpose_context.value:
("comment_threads"."purpose" = 'private' AND "comment_threads"."publication_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("comment_threads"."purpose" = 'public' AND "comment_threads"."publication_id" IS NOT NULL)

crypto_jobs_rotation_metadata.name: crypto_jobs_rotation_metadata
crypto_jobs_rotation_metadata.value:
"crypto_jobs"."progress" >= 0 AND ("crypto_jobs"."kind" != 'key_rotation' OR
    ("crypto_jobs"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crypto_jobs"."key_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "crypto_jobs"."key_epoch" >= 1 AND "crypto_jobs"."initiating_account_id" IS NOT NULL))

directory_entries_ciphertext_bounded.name: directory_entries_ciphertext_bounded
directory_entries_ciphertext_bounded.value:
length("directory_entries"."name_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    AND length("directory_entries"."order_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    AND length("directory_entries"."key_envelope") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384

file_representations_head_complete.name: file_representations_head_complete
file_representations_head_complete.value:
("file_representations"."key_envelope" IS NULL AND "file_representations"."head_digest" IS NULL
    AND "file_representations"."head_signature" IS NULL AND "file_representations"."head_device_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("file_representations"."key_envelope" IS NOT NULL AND length("file_representations"."key_envelope") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384
      AND "file_representations"."head_digest" IS NOT NULL AND length("file_representations"."head_digest") = 32
      AND "file_representations"."head_signature" IS NOT NULL AND length("file_representations"."head_signature") = 64 AND "file_representations"."head_device_id" IS NOT NULL)

files_capability_pair.name: files_capability_pair
files_capability_pair.value:
("files"."capability_id" IS NULL AND "files"."capability_epoch" IS NULL)
    OR ("files"."capability_id" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."capability_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."capability_epoch" >= 1)

import_records_payload_bounded.name: import_records_payload_bounded
import_records_payload_bounded.value:
("import_records"."kind" IN ('node-directory', 'node-file') AND "import_records"."length" = 0)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" IN ('entry-name', 'entry-order', 'comment-attribution') AND "import_records"."length" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" IN ('directory-capability', 'file-capability', 'entry-key', 'representation-key',
        'comment-thread', 'comment-body', 'comment-key', 'comment-attribution-key', 'comment-meta')
        AND "import_records"."length" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" IN ('representation', 'public-representation', 'listing-ciphertext') AND "import_records"."length" BETWEEN 1 AND 524288)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" = 'file-head' AND "import_records"."length" = 96)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" = 'replace' AND "import_records"."length" = 8)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" = 'listing-digest' AND "import_records"."length" = 32)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" = 'listing-signature' AND "import_records"."length" = 64)

import_records_refs_bounded.name: import_records_refs_bounded
import_records_refs_bounded.value:
("import_records"."ref1" IS NULL OR length("import_records"."ref1") BETWEEN 1 AND 43)
      AND ("import_records"."ref2" IS NULL OR length("import_records"."ref2") BETWEEN 1 AND 43)
      AND ("import_records"."ref3" IS NULL OR length("import_records"."ref3") BETWEEN 1 AND 43)
      AND ("import_records"."ref4" IS NULL OR length("import_records"."ref4") BETWEEN 1 AND 43)

import_records_shape.name: import_records_shape
import_records_shape.value:
("import_records"."kind" IN ('listing-ciphertext', 'listing-digest', 'listing-signature')
        AND "import_records"."ref1" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref2" IS NULL AND "import_records"."ref3" IS NULL AND "import_records"."ref4" IS NULL)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" IN ('node-directory', 'node-file', 'entry-name', 'entry-order', 'directory-capability',
        'entry-key', 'file-head', 'replace', 'comment-meta', 'comment-body', 'comment-key',
        'comment-attribution', 'comment-attribution-key')
        AND "import_records"."ref1" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref2" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref3" IS NULL AND "import_records"."ref4" IS NULL)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" IN ('file-capability', 'representation-key', 'representation', 'public-representation')
        AND "import_records"."ref1" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref2" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref3" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref4" IS NULL)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" = 'comment-thread'
        AND "import_records"."ref1" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref2" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref3" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."ref4" IS NOT NULL)

import_records_header_fields.name: import_records_header_fields
import_records_header_fields.value:
("import_records"."kind" IN ('entry-name', 'entry-order', 'directory-capability', 'file-capability', 'entry-key',
        'representation-key', 'representation', 'public-representation', 'comment-thread', 'comment-body',
        'comment-key', 'comment-attribution', 'comment-attribution-key', 'listing-ciphertext', 'comment-meta')
        AND "import_records"."header_key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."header_key_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."header_key_epoch" >= 1
        AND "import_records"."header_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."header_revision" >= 1)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" NOT IN ('entry-name', 'entry-order', 'directory-capability', 'file-capability', 'entry-key',
        'representation-key', 'representation', 'public-representation', 'comment-thread', 'comment-body',
        'comment-key', 'comment-attribution', 'comment-attribution-key', 'listing-ciphertext', 'comment-meta')
        AND "import_records"."header_key_id" IS NULL AND "import_records"."header_key_epoch" IS NULL AND "import_records"."header_revision" IS NULL)

import_records_file_head.name: import_records_file_head
import_records_file_head.value:
("import_records"."kind" = 'file-head' AND "import_records"."head_device_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."signer_device_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" = 'listing-signature' AND "import_records"."signer_device_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."head_device_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("import_records"."kind" NOT IN ('file-head', 'listing-signature')
        AND "import_records"."head_device_id" IS NULL AND "import_records"."signer_device_id" IS NULL)

import_sessions_expected_bounded.name: import_sessions_expected_bounded
import_sessions_expected_bounded.value:
"import_sessions"."expected_record_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 2000
      AND "import_sessions"."expected_chunk_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 40
      AND "import_sessions"."expected_payload_bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 20971520
      AND "import_sessions"."expected_comment_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000

import_sessions_uploaded_bounded.name: import_sessions_uploaded_bounded
import_sessions_uploaded_bounded.value:
"import_sessions"."uploaded_chunks" BETWEEN 0 AND "import_sessions"."expected_chunk_count"
      AND "import_sessions"."uploaded_records" BETWEEN 0 AND "import_sessions"."expected_record_count"
      AND "import_sessions"."uploaded_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND "import_sessions"."expected_payload_bytes"

import_sessions_commit_state.name: import_sessions_commit_state
import_sessions_commit_state.value:
("import_sessions"."state" = 'committed' AND "import_sessions"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("import_sessions"."state" != 'committed' AND "import_sessions"."committed_at" IS NULL)

key_rotation_entries_bounded.name: key_rotation_entries_bounded
key_rotation_entries_bounded.value:
length("key_rotation_entries"."name_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    AND length("key_rotation_entries"."order_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND length("key_rotation_entries"."key_envelope") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384

pseudonym_update_items_shape.name: pseudonym_update_items_shape
pseudonym_update_items_shape.value:
("pseudonym_update_items"."kind" = 'thread' AND "pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_envelope" IS NOT NULL
      AND "pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_epoch" >= 1)
    OR ("pseudonym_update_items"."kind" = 'publication' AND "pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_envelope" IS NULL AND "pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_epoch" IS NULL)

pseudonym_update_items_bounded.name: pseudonym_update_items_bounded
pseudonym_update_items_bounded.value:
length("pseudonym_update_items"."ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    AND ("pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_envelope" IS NULL OR length("pseudonym_update_items"."content_key_envelope") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384)

publication_authors_declaration.name: publication_authors_declaration
publication_authors_declaration.value:
("publication_authors"."ciphertext" IS NULL AND "publication_authors"."link_id" IS NULL AND "publication_authors"."revision" >= 0)
    OR ("publication_authors"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "publication_authors"."link_id" IS NOT NULL AND "publication_authors"."revision" >= 1
      AND length("publication_authors"."ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)

publication_links_public_key.name: publication_links_public_key
publication_links_public_key.value:
typeof("publication_links"."public_key") = 'blob' AND length("publication_links"."public_key") = 65
    AND substr("publication_links"."public_key", 1, 1) = X'04'

publications_state_pointers.name: publications_state_pointers
publications_state_pointers.value:
("publications"."state" = 'active' AND "publications"."current_link_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "publications"."current_representation_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("publications"."state" = 'deleting' AND "publications"."current_link_id" IS NULL AND "publications"."current_representation_id" IS NULL)

rate_limit_counters_purpose_scope_valid.name: rate_limit_counters_purpose_scope_valid
rate_limit_counters_purpose_scope_valid.value:
("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" IN ('registration.challenge', 'registration.success') AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'webauthn.sign_in' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'account'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'recovery.attempt' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'recovery_identifier'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'vault_recovery.start' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'account'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'session.refresh' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'session')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'public_comment.mutate' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'account', 'publication', 'account_publication'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'public_comment.report' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'publication.mutate' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account')

rate_limit_counters_scope_id_valid.name: rate_limit_counters_scope_id_valid
rate_limit_counters_scope_id_valid.value:
("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'global' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_id" = '*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'network' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 72
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 8) = 'network:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 9) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'session' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 72
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 8) = 'session:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 9) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'recovery_identifier' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 84
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 20) = 'recovery_identifier:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 21) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account_publication' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 84
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 20) = 'account_publication:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 21) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 36
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 9, 1) = '-' AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 14, 1) = '-'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 15, 1) = '7' AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 19, 1) = '-'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b')
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 24, 1) = '-'
          AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_id" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'publication' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 43
          AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*')

security_events_account_id_opaque.name: security_events_account_id_opaque
security_events_account_id_opaque.value:
"security_events"."account_id" IS NULL OR (length("security_events"."account_id") = 36
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 9, 1) = '-' AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 14, 1) = '-'
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 15, 1) = '7' AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 19, 1) = '-'
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b')
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 24, 1) = '-'
        AND "security_events"."account_id" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*')

security_events_publication_id_opaque.name: security_events_publication_id_opaque
security_events_publication_id_opaque.value:
"security_events"."publication_id" IS NULL OR (length("security_events"."publication_id") = 43
        AND "security_events"."publication_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*')

security_events_network_bucket_bounded.name: security_events_network_bucket_bounded
security_events_network_bucket_bounded.value:
("security_events"."network_bucket" IS NULL AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("security_events"."network_bucket" IS NOT NULL AND length("security_events"."network_bucket") = 72
          AND substr("security_events"."network_bucket", 1, 8) = 'network:'
          AND substr("security_events"."network_bucket", 9) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'
          AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" >= "security_events"."created_at"
          AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" <= "security_events"."created_at" + 86400000
          AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" <= "security_events"."expires_at")

sharing_comment_capabilities_context.name: sharing_comment_capabilities_context
sharing_comment_capabilities_context.value:
("sharing_comment_capabilities"."purpose" = 'private-comment-thread'
    AND "sharing_comment_capabilities"."publication_id" IS NULL AND "sharing_comment_capabilities"."object_id" = "sharing_comment_capabilities"."thread_id") OR
    ("sharing_comment_capabilities"."purpose" = 'public-comment-audience-epoch' AND "sharing_comment_capabilities"."publication_id" IS NOT NULL)
